Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today in Court is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
3. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.225 of 2023, under Section 498A, 302, 304B IPC & Section 3/4 of POCSO Act, P.S. Rupaidiha, District Bahraich.
4. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the son of the applicant.

Subsequently, on 19.07.2023, the daughter was found dead and the entire family Laxmi Narayan Sonkar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. ... on 13 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88846878/

entities.text: Laxmi Narayan Sonkar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In terms of the post-mortem report, the cause of death is ante mortem strangulation and contusion injuries were observed on the body.

It is argued by counsel for the applicant that no specific allegation was levelled against the applicant of having harassed the daughter of the informant either mentally or physically in relation to demand of dowry.
5. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

6. Considering the fact that the applicant is father-in-law aged about 60 years and nothing specific has been stated against him coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and he is in custody since 27.07.2023, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Laxmi Narayan Sonkar be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
